methodology.primary: Tencent full-market rank plus detailed quotes
methodology.breadth_limits_turnover: recomputed from full-market detailed quotes; HiThink special pools retained separately
methodology.sector_limit: HiThink is preferred; without it, the complete Sina industry/concept catalogs discover leaders and Tencent quotes verify constituent breadth and capacity leaders
methodology.cross_source_timing: Live intraday use requires near-synchronous quotes. During the lunch break, the 11:30 Sina consensus timestamp anchors the close while Tencent may advance its display timestamp; prices must still match.
methodology.midday_close: Valid from 11:29 through 13:00 when the secondary consensus timestamp is 11:29-11:35 on the trade date and cross-source prices pass.
methodology.technical: EMA is auxiliary and omitted while no stable free 60-minute source is verified
